title: Shiloh Bates – CLO Investing at Flat Rock Global (EP.379)

reader_summary.headline: Shiloh Bates is the Chief Investment Officer at Flat Rock Global.
reader_summary.overview: Shiloh Bates is the Chief Investment Officer at Flat Rock Global, an alternative credit manager specializing in the junior tranches of CLOs. Last year, Shiloh published CLO Investing, a comprehensive review of the structure, payoff rules, and historical performance of CLOs. Our conversation covers Shiloh's twenty-five years spent in and around the space, an overview of the market, the characteristics of CLOs.
